title_en: The Most Important Causes of Disunity in the Muslim Community
description_en: The interview conducted by Al Mayadeen channel with His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari.
summary: In this interview with Al Mayadeen channel, His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the primary causes of division within the Muslim community (umma).
